payrollDeductions.description: Set yearly maximums on deductions such as pension and employment insurance, and let the paycheck stop collecting them once the maximum is reached.

emptyState.body: Pick the scheduled bill that is your paycheck, choose its deduction categories and set a yearly maximum for each. The bill stops collecting a deduction once its maximum is reached and starts again on the reset date.

form.billPlaceholder: Select the bill that is your paycheck
form.expectedHelp: The bill's line for this category is zero, so the forecast needs the amount each paycheck usually deducts.
form.expectedFromLine: The bill's line deducts {amount} per paycheck.
form.nextExpectedHelp: The amount each paycheck deducts from the next reset on. Leave it empty to keep this period's amount.

validation.expectedRequired: Enter the expected amount per paycheck

delete.message: Delete the {category} rule on {bill}? Posted transactions are not changed; the next paycheck posts its full line.
